name: Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG
summary: Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG is a family-owned machining shop founded in 1985, with 14 staff and turnover of 0-2 M EUR. The owner is personally involved and admits his costing is loose, done by his office manager, and was not tracked since the 2022 peak. He is now asking 7.0 % on the coupling hub from 2026-11-01, citing the April 2026 wage increase plus energy and material costs. At the same time the company is pushing us hard on our late payments and asking to be paid within 10 days.

situation.decision_maker: Owner decides prices personally (visits and calls). A new sales managing director has been in place since May 2026 and may front the correspondence.

negotiation_pattern: Asks a moderate increase every November and then accepts almost nothing. Mean asked +1.66 %, mean settled -1.22 %. The 2024 and 2025 rounds settled at 0.0-0.3 %. In 2023 they even accepted cuts of 3-4.3 %. They yield under pushback, but react sharply when they feel treated unfairly, e.g. over late payment: 'otherwise we will have to review our conditions'. The current 7.0 % ask is far above the pattern and comes 12 days after they re-quoted the same part at the unchanged EUR 16.30.
wants: Being paid on time and fast (10 days), in exchange for cash discount
Fair, respectful treatment and recognition of long reliable supply
Some recovery of the April 2026 wage increase
Continued steady volume, especially the 100 % coupling hub share
protects: Payment discipline: will not keep accepting overdue invoices
Some price relief for the wage increase; will resist a flat zero if cost transparency shows a real rise

trades.give: payment_days: pay within 10-14 days and reliably take the 2 % skonto they offered
trades.get: unit_price increase on part:320060 cut to the history range (~0-1 %), not 7.0 %
trades.why: They explicitly asked for faster payment against a discount, and our late payments are their sore point.

trades.give: accept the owner's offer of an open-book review of hourly rates and material
trades.get: price set on verified cost; energy and material since the 2022 peak are likely overstated
trades.why: The owner admitted he has not followed his costs since 2022 and offered to show the calculation.

trades.give: contract_months: extend the framework beyond 2027-06-30 and confirm the 100 % coupling hub quota
trades.get: price hold or minimal increase, effective_date no earlier than 2027-01-01
trades.why: Long-term commitment and steady volume move a family firm more than pressure does.

arguments.point: Prices are fixed per calendar year. A 01 Nov 2026 increase breaches clause 3.1; any change can apply from 2027-01-01 at the earliest.
You quoted EUR 16.30 for the coupling hub on 15 Sep 2026; a 7 % jump 12 days later needs a cost explanation.
Energy and material costs have come down from the 2022 peak. Let's go through your calculation together as you offered.
Delivery reliability is still below the agreed level: OTD 82.1 % against a 95 % target.
Past renewals were settled at around 0 %, so a fair outcome stays near that range.

avoid: Ignoring or downplaying their overdue-invoice complaint. Acknowledge it first.
Open threats of resourcing the coupling hub. A family owner digs in under pressure.
Promising faster payment and then paying late again (43 % of our payments are late)
tone: Personal and respectful, addressed to the owner. Acknowledge the long cooperation and our payment lapses, then firm on contract terms and cost facts.
red_flags: Relationship strain from our late payments; they threatened to 'review our conditions'.
Small 14-person shop with weak costing (office manager): key-person and pricing-error risk.
OTD 82.1 % is well below the 95 % target. Coupling hub (part:320060) is sourced 100 % here; one alternative source exists and the tooling is ours.
Plant closes 23 Dec-6 Jan, so January call-offs are needed by 10 Dec.

evidence.claim: Asks 7.0 % (EUR 16.30 → 17.44) on part:320060 from 2026-11-01, citing the April 2026 wage increase plus energy and material costs
Contract prices are fixed per calendar year with 90 days' notice; framework runs until 2027-06-30
Complained about overdue invoices and asked for payment within 10 days against a cash discount
Owner has not tracked costs since 2022 and offered an open-book calculation
Scorecard is green, class A, but OTD of 82.1 % misses the 95 % target
Past renewals settled at 0.0-0.3 % despite asks of 1.3-4.2 %

indicators.credit_index: 255 (12 months ago 255; higher is worse, >300 weak)
